name: Kjeragbolten
why: Three steep ridges with chains on bare rock to a boulder wedged in a crack 1,000 m above the Lysefjord.
book: Free: the Norwegian right to roam (allemannsretten). Paid parking at the trailhead. Parking at Øygardstøl (Eagle's Nest), 2.5 h from Stavanger by road; the road opens in late May or June.
water: Streams between the ridges. Cafe at Øygardstøl.
dangers: Steep slabs with chains: slippery when wet.
Stepping onto the boulder is your own risk: a fall is fatal.
Weather turns fast: fog, rain and wind even in July. Check yr.no and turn back in fog.
turnaround: Do not climb the ridges in rain or fog.
